title: N-Queens Count
statement:
The N-Queens problem asks: in how many ways can N non-attacking queens be placed on an N×N chessboard?

Two queens attack each other if they share the same row, column, or diagonal.

Given N, print the number of distinct solutions.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of ways to place N non-attacking queens.

examples.explanation: There are exactly 2 solutions for the 4-queens problem.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
